an10.239:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, ten things are to be developed.
an10.239:1.3: Right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration, right knowledge, and right liberation.
an10.239:1.4: For direct knowledge of lust, these ten things are to be developed.”
